verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents multiple workspaces that can be managed and chatted with through its API. Community and docs evidence also show that system prompts can be edited and models swapped. However, nothing explicitly ties distinct prompts and models to separate per-workspace agents, and nothing shows routing conversations or channels to specific agents. missing for 10: explicit per-workspace agent configuration (own prompt and model), documented routing of conversations or channels to distinct agents, hands-on corroboration of running multiple agents side by side.

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each

citations.quote: AnythingLLM supports a full developer API that you can use to manage, update, embed, and even chat with your workspaces
the ability to edit the system prompt, change the LLM temperature, and choose between open-source and closed models
Swap models, configure permissions, set up custom agent workflows
